name: Selimiye Mosque and its Social Complex
description: The Selimiye Mosque rises above the skyline of Edirne, the former Ottoman capital in western Türkiye. Architect Mimar Sinan built it for Sultan Selim II between 1568 and 1575 and called it his masterpiece. A single vast dome crowns the square prayer hall, four slender minarets flank it, and the interior glows with Iznik tiles. Schools, a covered market and a library surround it.
